verdict.rationale: monday.com's own integrations directory documents native Slack integration and GitHub pull-request linking to items, backed by a catalog of 850+ integrations and a no-development connection claim. Google Drive is never named; only Gmail and Google Calendar appear. All evidence is vendor marketing, with no hands-on corroboration of integration depth. Missing for 10: documented Google Drive integration, detailed docs on Slack/GitHub integration setup and depth, independent or hands-on corroboration.
